## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长百分比及计算过程

**原始数字（来自 `financial_statements.txt` → Segment Results 工作表）：**
- FY26 Q4（截至2026年6月30日三个月）Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$39,306 million**
- FY25 Q4（截至2025年6月30日三个月）Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$29,878 million**

**计算过程：**

$$\text{同比增长率} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} \times 100\% = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \times 100\% \approx 31.6\%$$

四舍五入后为 **32%**，与管理层在电话会中的表述一致。

**交叉验证**：`transcript.txt`（位置 24848）明确写道："Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment. Revenue was **$39.3 billion** and grew **32%** and 31% in constant currency." `metrics.txt` 中 Azure and other cloud services revenue growth (y/y) 标注为 43% / 43%（GAAP / Constant Currency），与分部口径一致。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（引用电话会记录原话）

出处：`transcript.txt`，位置 **24848–25130**（Amy Hood 准备发言，段落 "Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment…"）

管理层将 Intelligent Cloud（核心为 Azure）32% 的增长归因于以下因素：

> **(a)** "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.**"

> **(b)** "**Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet** as well as **process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.**"

> **(c)** "**That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized.**"

> **(d)** "Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

此外，在 on-premises server 子业务上（属于 Intelligent Cloud 分部）：

> **(e)** "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. **Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

---

### 3. 事实 vs 前瞻性表述的逐条标注

| 编号 | 归因内容 | 性质 | 判断依据 |
|------|---------|------|---------|
| (a) | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | **已发生的事实（对当前状态的描述）** | "continues" 表明这是对 FY26 Q4 期间持续存在的供需状态的陈述。Amy Hood 在后续 Q&A 中进一步确认："there are still constraints in the system… demand continues to exceed available supply, and that certainly remains true." 这是对已发生事实的总结，不是对未来做出的承诺或预测。 |
| (b) | "efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | **已发生的事实** | 描述的是 FY26 Q4 季度内已经实现的效率提升成果。Amy Hood 在 Q&A（位置 41227）中举例说明："We saw a good work this quarter, in particular, from our engineering teams to make as much of that available as we could." 时态为过去式。 |
| (b) | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | **已发生的事实** | 描述的是过去90天内已经完成的过程改进。Amy Hood 在 Q&A 中说："some of the process improvements we've made… was also improved over the past 90 days." 明确是已完成的动作。 |
| (c) | "additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized" | **已发生的事实** | "was quickly monetized" 为过去完成时，描述的是 Q4 季度内已经发生的事件。 |
| (d) | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | **已发生的事实** | June business model change（6月商业模式变更）已经发生，"stronger-than-expected consumption" 是对已实现结果的评价。 |
| (e) | "renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" | **已发生的事实** | 描述的是 Q4 已完成的续约合同结构带来的收入确认效果。 |

**结论**：管理层对 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 32% 增长的全部归因均属于**已发生的事实**，没有包含前瞻性表述。所有归因使用的都是过去时态（"grew"、"was driven"、"was quickly monetized"、"benefited"），描述的是 Q4 季度内已经完成的事件和已经实现的状态。

需要注意的是，在 transcript 的 outlook 部分（位置 32535 之后），Amy Hood 确实做出了前瞻性表述，例如："we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"（预计 H1 增速将加速）以及 Azure "we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency"——但这些是**对未来的指引**，不属于对 Q4 实际增长的解释归因。

---

**关键出处汇总：**
- 收入数字：`financial_statements.txt` → Segment Results 工作表（行 "Intelligent Cloud / Revenue"）
- 分部增长描述：`transcript.txt` 位置 24848–25130
- Azure 效率与产能细节：`transcript.txt` 位置 40349、41227（Q&A 部分）
- 下一季度指引：`transcript.txt` 位置 32535 之后
